messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Thu, Apr 01, 2021, Homeo Morphism wrote:
>gnu version 10.2.0
We don't support version 10 of the GNU compilers. You will have to use GNU
9 or earlier.
...dac
p.s.: with a small amount of work, one can get Amber to *compile* correctly,
but not all programs run correctly.
